title: Typed adapter boundary with schema validation
objective: Accept custodian data only through versioned typed adapter contracts with explicit schemas, size limits and origin verification; reject malformed or unverifiable input.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound integrations owner; sponsor Treasury for entitlements)

title: Provider capability matrix enforcement
objective: Permit only operations listed in the integration's verified capability profile; read-only integrations cannot emit instructions.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound integrations owner; sponsor Treasury for entitlements)

title: Custodian credential management
objective: Store custodian credentials in managed secret storage with scoped service accounts and rotation.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound integrations owner; sponsor Treasury for entitlements)

title: Funds-flow conformance check
objective: Before activation, verify the deployment has no operator-owned, FBO or pooled account and no Unbound credential able to execute a payment; block activation on failure.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound product owner; sponsor legal for titling)
notes: L1 applies only to the scope 'Unbound-held funds'; relay of sponsor-authorized instructions is not eliminated.

title: Omnibus attribution declaration and per-security reconciliation
objective: Reject multi-fund allocation to any custody account without a declared attribution method; reconcile lot-owned positions per security to the custodian.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound product owner; sponsor legal for titling)

title: Partner-scoped custody mapping
objective: Bind every custody account mapping to sponsor and partner tenant keys; never authorize by provider account identifier alone.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound product owner; sponsor legal for titling)

title: Custodian-to-subledger reconciliation
objective: Reconcile custodian positions, cash, transactions and fees to the investment subledger daily and before statement publication.

title: Statement block on stale or missing manager price
objective: Block issuance of fund statements whose values rely on a missing or stale custodian or manager price.

title: Critical-vendor assurance register with CUEC mapping
objective: Track custodian assurance reports, periods, opinions and exceptions; require each CUEC mapped to an owner before Assured status; expire assurance automatically.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor vendor risk owner with Unbound support)

title: Annual custodian SOC report review
objective: Qualified reviewer evaluates custodian SOC 1 Type 2 scope, exceptions and subservice carve-outs and records conclusions.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor vendor risk owner with Unbound support)

title: Typed instruction state machine with authorization gate
objective: Model each trade or cash instruction as an explicit state machine; transitions to Submitted require recorded sponsor authority, limits and independent approval.

title: Idempotent instruction keys
objective: Every external instruction carries a durable idempotency key; retries reuse it and duplicates are rejected.

title: Live rail invocation prohibition (pre-production)
objective: Deny any live custodian or payment rail call from non-production or unauthorized environments.

title: Degraded-mode state machine for custodian sources
objective: On outage or staleness, move the source to an explicit degraded state that holds dependent actions and shows freshness warnings.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound operations owner with sponsor Treasury)

title: Custodian transition reconciliation
objective: Reconcile positions, lots and cash between outgoing and incoming custodians before activating the new mapping.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound operations owner with sponsor Treasury)
